---
title: "Popular Baby Names in the US"
author: "Andrew Lucas"
format: html
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)

# Find all baby name text files in the data directory
files <- list.files("data", pattern = "yob.*\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

# Read and combine the data files into a single tibble
baby_names <- read_csv(
  files,
  id = "file",
  col_names = c("name", "sex", "n"),
  col_types = "cci",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    # Extract the 4-digit year from the filename
    year = as.integer(str_extract(file, "\\d{4}")),
    # Use clear labels for gender
    sex = if_else(sex == "F", "Female", "Male")
  ) |>
  select(year, sex, name, n)

# Get sorted list of unique names for the dropdown
unique_names <- sort(unique(baby_names$name))
```

```{r}
#| panel: sidebar
# Dropdown menu to select a name
selectizeInput(
  inputId = "name",
  label = "Select Name:",
  choices = NULL
)

# Radio buttons to choose gender
radioButtons(
  inputId = "gender",
  label = "Gender:",
  choices = c("Male", "Female", "Both"),
  selected = "Both"
)
```

```{r}
#| panel: fill
# Display the popularity plot
plotOutput("popularity_plot")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
# Populate name choices on the server side for fast loading
updateSelectizeInput(
  session,
  "name",
  choices = unique_names,
  selected = "Mary",
  server = TRUE
)

output$popularity_plot <- renderPlot({
  req(input$name)

  # Filter data for the selected name
  plot_data <- baby_names |>
    filter(name == input$name)

  # Filter by gender if Male or Female is selected
  if (input$gender != "Both") {
    plot_data <- plot_data |>
      filter(sex == input$gender)
  }

  validate(
    need(nrow(plot_data) > 0, "No records found for this combination.")
  )

  # Create the popularity plot
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = year, y = n, color = sex)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Female" = "#E64B35", "Male" = "#4DBBD5")) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Popularity of the Name", input$name),
      subtitle = "Number of babies born per year in the US",
      x = "Year",
      y = "Number of Babies",
      color = "Gender"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
})
```
